nodes.label: Cold Chain Monitor Concept Image
nodes.rationale: Concept illustration of IoT temperature sensor device projecting a holographic dashboard showing a temperature spike, dose-disposition alert, and tamper-evident log.

nodes.label: IoT Sensor/Gateway Device
nodes.rationale: White puck-shaped IoT hardware device wired to the medical fridge, projecting the dashboard UI.

nodes.label: Temperature Excursion Chart
nodes.rationale: Line chart showing a sharp red temperature spike deviation from baseline teal trend line.

nodes.label: Dose-Disposition Quarantine Alert
nodes.rationale: UI panel reading 'Dose-disposition: Quarantine batch — review'.

nodes.label: Tamper-Evident Log
nodes.rationale: UI panel with lock/chain icon labeled 'Tamper-evident log'.

nodes.label: Medical Refrigerator/Vaccine Storage Unit
nodes.rationale: Open medical-grade refrigerator with vials/medication boxes being accessed by a hand.

nodes.label: Surplus Matching for Growers Concept Image
nodes.rationale: Mockup photo of rugged tablet showing delivery-routing/matching app UI next to crates of surplus produce.

nodes.label: Surplus Matching App UI (Tablet Mockup)
nodes.rationale: On-screen UI: produce thumbnail, verified/quality badge icon, map with farm icon branching via routes to multiple pinned delivery destinations.

nodes.label: Disability Funding Reassessment Dashboard Illustration
nodes.rationale: Stock-style illustration of tablet showing two bar charts (verified/completed metric and goal/target metric) with wireless signal icon.

nodes.label: E-Waste Routing Concept Image
nodes.rationale: Illustrates app scanning broken devices and routing them to repair or recycling.

nodes.label: Neighbourhood SDG Indicator Map Mockup
nodes.rationale: 3D aerial map of residential neighbourhood with highlighted green park parcel and a gauge/dial UI suggesting a livability or sustainability score.

nodes.label: Patient Health Literacy Tablet UI
nodes.rationale: Illustration of patient viewing simplified discharge/medication instructions on tablet with icon-based summary alongside dense original text.

nodes.label: Disaster Recovery Shocks - Emergency Response Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Photo of silhouetted people viewing screen showing flood map with red heat-cluster markers plus a ranked bar-list metrics panel.

nodes.label: Surplus Food Allocation / Food Rescue Concept
nodes.rationale: Concept image showing commercial kitchen with tray of surplus cooked food, timer icon, and phone displaying chat prompt, safety-verified checkmark, and ranked recipient locations.

nodes.label: Food Safety Verification Icon (Shield Checkmark)
nodes.rationale: Green shield with checkmark UI element implying food safety validation step before allocation/dispatch.

nodes.label: Ranked Recipient Locations List (1-2-3 pins)
nodes.rationale: UI list showing three ranked pin-marked locations, implying allocation/routing algorithm.

nodes.label: Crisis Response Allocation Engine Diagram
nodes.rationale: Diagram showing flood-risk heatmap map and supply-chain flow (Food pallet -> Supply-depot -> Evacuation-centre).

nodes.label: Flood Risk Heatmap / Road Network Map
nodes.rationale: Map panel showing flood risk heat zones, road closures, and route network.

nodes.label: Supply Chain Flow: Food Pallet to Evacuation Centre
nodes.rationale: Icon flow depicting logistics pipeline from food pallet to supply depot to evacuation centre via verified route.

nodes.label: Universal Jargon Interpreter App
nodes.rationale: Product concept mockup: phone camera scanning handwritten prescription and translating it into plain-language, verified summary card.

nodes.label: Camera Scan Split-View UI
nodes.rationale: Split-screen phone UI: live camera feed of handwritten note, dark card with plain-language summary.

nodes.label: Verified Plain-Language Summary Card
nodes.rationale: UI element with trust badge indicating verified, grounded content summary.

nodes.label: Target Documents (Prescription, Tenancy Agreement)
nodes.rationale: Physical props: handwritten prescription and printed tenancy agreement representing jargon-heavy document types.
